stackDescriptions.core: Everyday repository work, debugging, delivery, web/API changes, tools, documentation and basic operations.
stackDescriptions.build-and-ship: Take a feature from understanding and design through implementation, review, tests and a PR.
stackDescriptions.diagnose-and-repair: Reproduce a failure, inspect code/runtime evidence, repair it and prove the result.
stackDescriptions.operate-homelab: Operate services and personal tools, investigate incidents, change infrastructure and verify recovery.
stackDescriptions.build-agent-tools: Build and configure agents, MCP servers, CLIs, retrieval, evaluations and development environments.
stackDescriptions.research-and-write: Find and check sources, develop an argument, write or revise, and produce documents.
stackDescriptions.product-and-launch: Research a market, choose positioning, prepare brand/product copy, refine the interface and plan a launch.
stackDescriptions.creative-production: Plan and produce visual, audio, video or slide material with a coherent voice and delivery format.
stackDescriptions.fiction-and-worlds: Develop stories and settings, draft scenes, revise character/dialogue, and maintain continuity.
stackDescriptions.learn-and-practice: Plan learning, study examples, tutor, build exercises and review progress.
stackDescriptions.mobile-and-interfaces: Build and test mobile, terminal, editor, browser and interactive interfaces.
stackDescriptions.data-and-decisions: Investigate evidence, analyze data, compare alternatives and communicate a decision.

clientPolicy: Cursor and Copilot receive Claude-compatible Agent Skills files, not an assertion of tool equivalence. Runtime tool checks still apply. Package-owned, application-specific and project-local skills retain their owners.
